## About
Peruva started as a small garage in San Rafael run by Luis Arcos, our president. Luis fell for cars as a kid, learned by watching mechanics and working on his family's cars, then trained in engines and transmissions at an automobile mechanic school in Lima.
When he came to the United States, Luis went to work at the Rino Gas Station in Fairfax, where he made friends and kept learning. Over the years he earned the trust and friendship of a lot of customers, and today Peruva has shops in San Rafael, Fairfax and Sausalito.
Our Fairfax shop on Bolinas Rd handles the everyday maintenance and the bigger repairs your car needs. Customer safety and satisfaction come first, and our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 37 Google reviews.

## Services
- Engine and transmission: Engine repair, maintenance and performance checks, plus transmission diagnostics, maintenance and replacement.
- Tires and alignment: Tire replacement and repair, plus wheel alignment.
- Air conditioning repair and service: Repair and service for your car's air conditioning.
- Exhaust repair: Exhaust repair and replacement.
- Electrical repairs: Electrical diagnostics, alternators and starters, power windows, locks and steering, wipers, and light and bulb replacement.
- Fuel injection repair and service: Repair and service for fuel injection.
- Cooling system repair: Repair for your car's cooling system.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Fill out the appointment form, choose the Fairfax location, and we'll email you to confirm. Please allow us 24 hours to confirm your appointment.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Give us a call. We work on all kinds of things your car needs, and we're happy to talk it through.
